item.title: FAQ
item.description:
Getting Started

Do I need an invitation to join?

Yes. Shabash is invite-only. Every new family joins using a Golden Ticket code shared by an existing Shabash family. This keeps the community tight-knit and spam-free.

If you don’t have a code yet, you can join the waitlist from the sign-up page and we’ll reach out when a spot opens up.

How do I get a Golden Ticket?

Golden Tickets are awarded to families once they complete the core onboarding steps: verify your email, add at least one child, and create your first chore and reward. After that, your dashboard shows a unique code with 5 invite slots you can share with friends.

item.title: Getting Started
item.description:
Welcome to Shabash! This guide will walk you through the basic steps to start managing chores with your family.

1. Create a Family Account

  1. Navigate to the homepage and click Get Started.
  2. Fill out your email, display name, and password. An email verification code will be sent to you.
  3. Enter the code to verify your email and activate your account.

By default, the first user becomes a family parent and a new family is created. You can invite other parents and children later.
